data.name: Dream Cola
data.detailed_description:
Dream Cola is a short PSX-style psychological horror game that mixes creepy moments with humorous situations to create a fun and unique experience. As you play, you'll uncover strange events and unexpected secrets in a mysterious world. The game focuses on light horror rather than intense scares or disturbing content.

Dream Cola features both funny and spooky moments, making it a great choice for players who enjoy a balance between horror and comedy. The game also includes no background music, helping create a quiet and unsettling atmosphere.

Features:

  • Classic PSX-inspired visuals.

  • A mix of light horror and comedy.

  • Short story-driven experience.

  • No background music.

  • Full support for Arabic and English languages.
